philosophy: WATCH → TRACE → UNDERSTAND. Don't just show what the algorithm does; show the process that produces the result and explain why each step happens with absolute visual & textual clarity.

tech_stack.components: Shadcn UI primitives customized + Lucide React icons

themes.toggle_mechanism: Manual toggle switch in Header, persisting to localStorage and setting 'dark' class on <html> element

usage_rules.Inter: Use for Header brand title, navigation tabs, section headings, action buttons, descriptions, step inspector prose, general UI labels.
usage_rules.JetBrains Mono: Use strictly for step counters, array cell values, trace indices, queue/stack node labels, data structures state values, code snippets, complexity Big-O notations.

scale.tagline: text-xs font-normal tracking-wide text-muted-foreground hidden sm:inline-block
scale.technical_badge: font-mono text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded

semantic_visualization_states.description: Visual feedback MUST use both color AND distinct geometric indicators (icons, badges, outlines, elevation) to ensure accessibility and clarity.

active.label: Active Pointer / Current Focus
active.indicator: Pointer arrow overlay + pulse animation + bold border

comparing.label: Comparing Elements
comparing.indicator: Double-headed arrow badge or amber outline ring

swapping.label: Swapping Elements
swapping.indicator: Horizontal swap curved arrows icon + spring transition

selected.label: Selected / Sub-range (Pivot / Low / High / Mid)
selected.indicator: Distinct label badge above element (e.g. LOW, MID, HIGH, PIVOT)

visited.label: Visited (Graph / Tree Traversal)
visited.indicator: Checkmark icon inside node + subtle hashed border

found.label: Target Found / Match
found.indicator: Target bullseye icon badge + scale pulse ring

sorted.label: Sorted / Completed State
sorted.indicator: Lock icon or solid green fill with subtle top shine

header.position: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-background/90 border-b border-border
elements: 5 Algorithm Tabs (Bubble Sort, Merge Sort, Binary Search, BFS, DFS)

algorithm_page_flow.description: Algorithm title, algorithm badge, brief functional explanation, and target domain.
Interactive dataset generator (Randomize, Custom Array input text field with validation, Target value input for binary search, preset graph selectors).
Min height 360px - 440px. High visual hierarchy container with clean grid background, dynamic rendering of bars, trees, arrays, or graph nodes. Displays live pointers and index labels.
Sticky/pinned floating control deck with First Step (|<), Prev Step (<), Play/Pause, Next Step (>), Last Step (>|), Reset, Speed slider (0.25x to 4x), and interactive Progress Bar scrubbing.

Three structured sub-cards: [1] What's Happening Now (Direct observation), [2] Why This Step Matters (Algorithm intuition & invariants), [3] Live Trace Variables (State counters, indices, active stack/queue contents).
4 compact metrics: Best Case Time Complexity, Average Case Time Complexity, Worst Case Time Complexity, and Space Complexity with clear Big-O syntax and explanation tooltip.

bubble_sort.name: Bubble Sort
bubble_sort.unique_features: Outer loop counter (Pass i), inner loop pointer (j vs j+1 comparison), swapped flag indicator, rightmost elements lock into 'sorted' state as passes complete.

merge_sort.name: Merge Sort
merge_sort.visual_mode: Recursive Tree Decomposition + Merging Array Buffer
merge_sort.unique_features: Split phase visualized as tree levels, merge phase showing 2 sorted subarrays combining into target array with dual pointers.

binary_search.name: Binary Search
binary_search.unique_features: Target value highlights, low (blue), high (amber), mid (teal active) indicators, dimmed out-of-range discarded halves on each step.

bfs.name: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
bfs.visual_mode: Node Graph Diagram + FIFO Queue Deck
bfs.unique_features: Graph with numbered nodes & edges, highlight current node, push adjacent nodes into animated FIFO Queue strip, mark visited nodes with checkmarks.

dfs.name: Depth-First Search (DFS)
dfs.visual_mode: Node Graph Diagram + LIFO Stack Deck
dfs.unique_features: Graph traversal with active backtracking indication, push to LIFO Stack strip, mark visited nodes, highlight stack pop and push operations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the WATCH → TRACE → UNDERSTAND design principle.
Implement Light and Dark modes with clean transitions and persist the setting in localStorage.
Use Inter for UI elements and JetBrains Mono selectively for technical data, step counters, arrays, code, and complexity cards.
Ensure all 5 algorithms are fully operational with step-by-step frame generation, state inspection, and playback control.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, canvas elements, step counters, and inspector panels for testing verification.
Keep spacing generous and layout calm: minimal visual noise, subtle borders, high clarity.
